written.title: GTA 6's First TV Ad Cuts The Spicy Shower Scenes
written.description: What Kotaku and IGN reported about Lucia Caminos on 21 October 2026, quoted in their own words with a link to each report.
written.body:
This page collects what named outlets published about Lucia Caminos, in their own words. This site wrote none of the sentences in quotation marks below. Each one links to the report it was taken from.

## Kotaku, 21 October 2026

[GTA 6's First TV Ad Cuts The Spicy Shower Scenes](https://kotaku.com/gta-6s-first-tv-ad-cuts-the-spicy-shower-scenes-2000748474)

The outlet's own summary:

> But, we get a few extra milliseconds of new footage, so that's something

> And a few more frames were included in the bit where Lucia jumps off a truck and onto a plane’s landing gear.

## IGN, 22 October 2026

[First GTA 6 TV Commercial Strips Out Steamy Shower Scenes, but Shows More of Lucia's Fancy Hair Tech](https://www.ign.com/articles/gta-6-tv-commercial-strips-shower-scene-doesnt-mention-xbox)

The outlet's own summary:

> GTA 6 has its first TV commercial, and it's a little different than the launch trailer.

> Yesterday, people spotted GTA 6 Burger Shot restaurants pop up in the Kaseya Center.

> Back To Top Home › News › GTA 6 First GTA 6 TV Commercial Strips Out Steamy Shower Scenes, but Shows More of Lucia's Fancy Hair Tech Pouring cold water.

> Miami is currently completely taken over by the game, which is set in a fictionalized Miami called Vice City, as well as the surrounding area.

## IGN, 25 October 2026

['A Lot of People Want to Get to Know Me' — GTA 6 Fans Swarm Rumored Lucia Actress Manni L. Perez's Livestream](https://www.ign.com/articles/rumored-lucia-actress-goes-viral-after-dodging-swarm-of-gta-6-comments-during-livestream)

The outlet's own summary:

> Manni L. Perez, the actress long rumored to be playing Lucia in GTA 6, has gone viral after dodging a swarm of comments from Grand Theft Auto fans during a recent livestream.

> Who has been confirmed, whether Rockstar and any likely NDAs like it or not, is Stephen Root, who said he will be seen playing drug trafficker Brian Heder .

> If you're wondering who might be playing Lucia's partner in crime, Jason, fans have long speculated that Modern Family and Grey's Anatomy actor Dylan Rourke filled the role, but he, too, has yet to be confirmed.

> Back To Top Home › News › GTA 6 Rumored Lucia Actress Goes Viral After Dodging Swarm of GTA 6 Comments During Livestream Law & order.

> Perez, the actress long rumored to be playing Lucia in GTA 6 , has gone viral after dodging a swarm of comments from Grand Theft Auto fans during a recent livestream.

> Lucia aka Manni Perez went live on Instagram by u/DMONEYDelano in GTA6unmoderated "But yeah, no, I'm not rich.

> Keep in mind that this all comes from years of clues gathered by fans, but Rockstar's lack of confirmation doesn't mean there's nothing to suggest Perez is playing Lucia in GTA 6.

Every report above is on the site's fixed source list. A report is not a confirmation: the mark on each linked entry says who said it.
